variant: retrofit for existing bulldozers and hydraulic excavators
name: AIM Intelligent Machines autonomous earthmoving retrofit
summary: Retrofit autonomy platform that turns customers' existing bulldozers and hydraulic excavators into autonomous earthmoving machines, used at mine sites and construction sites. A partnership with Komatsu and EARTHBRAIN (July 2026) links it to Smart Construction and has reached commercial deployment in the US, where Komatsu autonomous machines already work at customer jobsites; Japan is planned from 2027.

germany.statusNote: No German or European route found. The Komatsu partnership covers the US market now and Japan from 2027; AIM's site takes requests through a form and names no European office or dealer.

specs.label: Host machines
specs.quote: AIM’s technology can be retrofitted to existing bulldozers and hydraulic excavators, allowing customers to gradually introduce autonomous construction using their current fleets

specs.label: What it does
specs.value: machines read the project goals, plan methods and travel routes and carry out the earthmoving on their own
specs.conditions: with Komatsu Smart Construction plans and terrain data
specs.quote: Bulldozers and hydraulic excavators can understand project objectives, autonomously determine construction methods and travel routes, and execute construction tasks independently.

specs.label: Markets
specs.quote: The companies also plan to introduce the solution to the Japanese market beginning in 2027.

specs.label: Claimed savings
specs.value: USD 6.1 million annual opex savings from one six-machine autonomous fleet
specs.conditions: maker claim, site type not stated
specs.quote: $6.1M ANNUAL OPEX SAVINGS FROM A SINGLE SIX-MACHINE AUTONOMOUS FLEET

notes: Retrofit: the customer's dozer or excavator carries the AIM hardware; capabilities describe those tracked host machines.
AIM's site says it is commercially deployed at mine sites and construction sites worldwide; most named results are from mining.
Sensor set, supported brands and price were not found on readable pages.
